A Therapist Explains: The Real Symptoms of Pornography Withdrawal

Normalize therapy.
Normalize therapy.
254Likes
12KViews
2025Sep 15
Why does quitting porn feel so hard at the start? In this episode, we talk about the withdrawal symptoms most people never expect when they stop using pornography. It’s not just willpower. Your brain and body push back with irritability, brain fog, insomnia, anxiety, depression, and even emotional numbness. These symptoms can feel overwhelming, but they are a normal part of the healing process. We explore what’s actually happening in the brain during withdrawal, why emotions feel so raw, and how physical symptoms like fatigue and restlessness show up. You’ll also hear why isolation makes things worse, how connection and support speed recovery, and why self-compassion is essential when your partner may not be ready to offer it. If you’re in the middle of withdrawal and wondering if it will ever get better, this episode gives you hope and practical guidance. ==   Struggling with relationships, trauma, or addictions?   You don’t have to do it alone.
